notes.title: Dayfly Artbook is out now!
notes.content:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3900100"][/dynamiclink]In this artbook, you'll uncover:
- What the Sefirot of Death and Fire looks like

- How many wings each incarnation of the Sefirot carries

- Why the Dayfly was originally named Paula

- Which ending could be considered the "true" one

...and so much more about the enigmatic world of Sefirot and Dayflies.
As a gift you'll receive two exclusive avatars featuring the main heroines of the game.
